meta.name: buzz-pitch
meta.description: Write media pitches and press releases — journalist outreach emails, podcast pitch scripts, newsletter sponsor pitches, and press release copy. Use when asked to "pitch journalists", "write a press release", "reach out to podcasts", or "get media coverage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写专业的媒体推介与新闻稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要向记者或媒体发布新闻或播客推介
copy.tagline_en: Write professional media pitches and press releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to contact journalists or get media coverage

howto.what: Claude会变成你的PR助手，根据你的需求撰写记者推介邮件、播客推介稿、新闻简报赞助稿或新闻稿，并附带媒体目标清单和辅助材料。
howto.when: 当你要求“推销给记者”、“写新闻稿”、“联系播客”或“获得媒体报道”时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一封推销给记者的邮件
say.note: Claude会先确认类型，然后研究记者，写出个性化邮件。

say.text: 写一份新闻稿，宣布新产品上线
say.note: Claude会按标准格式生成新闻稿，包括标题、引语等。

say.text: 为我的播客写一个推介稿
say.note: Claude会针对播客格式写出吸引人的推介内容。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes your PR assistant, writing journalist outreach emails, podcast pitch scripts, newsletter sponsor pitches, or press releases, and providing a media target list and supporting assets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'pitch journalists', 'write a press release', 'reach out to podcasts', or 'get media coverage'.

say_en.text: Write a pitch email for a journalist.
say_en.note: Claude identifies type, researches journalist, and crafts personalized email.

say_en.text: Draft a press release for a product launch.
say_en.note: Claude generates a standard press release with headline, quotes, etc.

say_en.text: Create a podcast pitch for my show.
say_en.note: Claude tailors pitch to podcast format, mentioning recent episodes.
